title: EICMA 2026 (Milan, Nov 2026): five new bikes from Royal Enfield, Hero MotoCorp and TVS and their India status: RE Continental GT 750 (743cc twin, twin exhausts; no power/price/India date), RE Himalayan 750 (55 hp, 63 Nm, UK £6,999; could debut in India at Motoverse late Nov per Autocar India), Hero Xpulse 450 (421cc liquid-cooled, 38 Nm, six-speed, 21-inch front; overseas first, India after per Hero), TVS Apache RTR 125 (14.7 hp, developed for Europe; India unconfirmed), Norton 450 Urban (TVS-owned; 454cc, 47 PS; no India date/price)
